findings.summary: The exported reset helper is a pass-through abstraction over a constant empty route query.
findings.consequence: It adds a public helper and dedicated unit-test surface without enforcing validation, preserving route state, or adapting backend/API types; the only direct caller could pass the same value inline.
findings.evidence: The owned function accepts _raw but returns only {} on line 365. The only production caller is app/pages/sök.vue:854, where resetSearch calls navigate(resetTextSearchQuery(rawQuery.value)); the named unit test at test/unit/text-search.spec.ts:382-384 asserts only that the result is {}.
findings.recommendation: Delete resetTextSearchQuery and have resetSearch call navigate({}) directly, or keep the helper only if a documented policy such as preserving selected non-search route params is added and tested.
